definitions.gloss: (with a negative) not at all; not in the least
definitions.explanation: Used with a negative to say that something has not happened or is not known at all, often for a long time: とんと{見|み}かけない (haven't seen them in ages). A slightly old-fashioned, conversational word, typical of older speakers.

examples.japanese: とんと⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とんと⟦{見|み}かけない→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧。
examples.english: I haven't seen him around at all lately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧ころ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧とんと⟦{遠出|とおで}→遠出：14430_toode⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しなく→する：00392_suru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I traveled a lot when I was young, but since getting older I've stopped going far altogether.

notes:
Almost always with a negative verb, or a verb such as ⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ that has a negative sense (とんと⟦{忘|わす}れていた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧, I had clean forgotten).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- とんと⟦{見|み}かけない→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧: never see (someone) any more
- とんと⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: have no idea at all
- とんと⟦{覚|おぼ}え→覚え：22843_oboe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: have no memory of it at all

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧: not at all; the everyday word
- ⟦さっぱり→さっぱり：02777_sappari⟧: not at all (with understanding: ⟦さっぱり→さっぱり：02777_sappari⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧)
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: not even a little
